greeting.message: Ah, back again? Good, good. The forge is always ready for someone who wants to learn.

responses.text: Do you have any crafting tips?

tips.message: The key to good crafting is understanding your materials. Each resource has unique properties - wood is flexible, stone is sturdy, crystal amplifies magic. Don't just follow recipes blindly; understand *why* they work.

more-tips.message: Remember, the best way to improve is to practice. Even failures teach you something. Now, let me get back to work - this forge won't tend itself.

checking-in.message: Well, everything's running smoothly here. The forge is hot, the anvil is ready, and we've got materials to spare. Just let me know when you're ready to craft something.
